title: Conditional κ = 0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769983114385025802954603275201628645482603256388263...: fixed-grid ceiling over PR2161
body:
This extends PR2161 by shrinking the free positive proof gaps together and **attains the maximum kappa on its unchanged floor grid and backoff**. With the unchanged certified complex endpoint C, floor F=10^30046 and backoff B=10^-30022, the new exact point is

`kappa = C - 1/F - B`.

The exact gain over #2161 is approximately **2.001681395341824885873407288e-30010**. It is still numerically tiny, not a material paid-supplier improvement. No word, owner map, physical invoice, primitive endpoint or inherited theorem hypothesis changes.

The proof is short: every point in this family has epsilon*q<C and C*F is integral, so floor(F*epsilon*q)/F-B <= C-1/F-B. The chosen r0=10^-30080 point has 0<C-epsilon*q<1/F and attains equality. PROOF.md states the exact scope: different grids, backoffs, suppliers and mechanisms are outside this cap.

Validation:
- All 62 retained strict inequalities, an explicit Gaussian-above-main family invariant, all 17 original mutation vectors, independent nine-cost equations, exact gain and ceiling attainment pass.
- Fresh actual evaluations of both unchanged fine engines at the new b=C-r0 return upper moments below one. PROVIDER-POINT.json is produced by the actual checker and bound by the full result producer.
- `PASS_SOURCE_BOUND_COMPLETE_FINITE_OUTER_REFINEMENT` binds the previously completed unchanged native/paid/controller/owner/geometry admission, both moment engines, adjacent-grid rejection and both 47-inequality assemblies. No new cold native replay is claimed for unchanged physical inputs.
- Registered Python 3.12 arithmetic replay, source/metadata checks, assertion-disabled rejection, privacy and diff checks pass.

The extra main-binding guard is intentional. When the kappa floor is much coarser than the new gaps, a beta outside the declared binding window may still exceed the lower rounded kappa. The guard enforces the original family's binding condition explicitly; no retained inequality, original mutation vector or parent checker assertion was removed.

Depends on #2161 / #2044. Parent package bytes and predecessor evidence are immutable. The previously disclosed parent Linux CRLF/LF aggregate limitation and unrelated historical split-skip pin failure remain; no whole-repository green or hosted-CI pass is claimed. All inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, recovery, analytic, prime-theorem and bit obligations remain conditional; no unconditional theorem or human review claim.

Credit PR2161, PR2044 / Jeremy Kothe, PR1786 (Chafik Boukhalfa / Tim Trudgian), PR1673 (Vlado Vojdanovski), PR1758 and the retained supplier/native/precision-repair lineage. Existing notices preserve full attribution. Prepared under dataisfire with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
